rustc 1.100.0 (0ef1bc386 2026-11-09)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: 0ef1bc386059596dada8fb65b50425aab2ea637a
commit-date: 2026-11-09
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.100.0
LLVM version: 23.1.5

settings.sharing: shared ztty broker plus every waiting launcher

method.ordering: fresh-process AB / BA alternating each round; window count order also alternates
method.timing: unchanged benchmark_terminals.py payload and HOME/DSR barrier; one active window at a time
method.aggregation: median of three bursts per window, median of windows per run, then median of runs
method.integrity: separate untimed replay requires direct CPR at 32;120 and all 32 final screen text rows; no rendering work is intentionally omitted
method.memory: pre-performance resident PSS including shared host and all waiting launchers; full memory snapshots and X server retained
method.host: available memory, swap use, swap I/O counters, pressure stalls, affinity and load recorded; unrelated work is left running
method.scope: Xvfb software rendering and logical PTY processing; not physical presentation or keyboard-to-photon latency

runs.dbus_config:
<busconfig>
  <type>session</type>
  <listen>unix:path=/tmp/ztty-compare-q96kwl0u/bus</listen>
  <auth>EXTERNAL</auth>
  <policy context="default">
    <allow own="*"/>
    <allow send_destination="*"/>
    <allow receive_sender="*"/>
  </policy>
  <!-- No service directories: this private bus only coordinates instances. -->
</busconfig>

pixmap_clients.scope: server PIXMAP resources attributed to the window's X client; not total GPU/driver/font memory
